printing.title: Printing
printing.intro: Each branch prints its orders by itself. One computer at the branch keeps a print page open, and every new order comes out on the printer next to it the moment it is placed (for online payments, once the payment is confirmed). Nobody has to open the dashboard or press print.
printing.step1: In Windows, make the receipt printer the default printer and set its paper to 80 mm.
printing.step2: Click "Copy Chrome shortcut" for the branch below, create a new Windows shortcut on that computer and paste it as the target. Put the shortcut in the Startup folder (Win+R, type shell:startup) so it opens by itself after a restart.
printing.step3: Open the shortcut and press "Print a test ticket". It must print without any pop-up. Keep the computer awake and the window open.
printing.private: Keep these links private: anyone who has one can read that branch's orders.

station.title: Print station
station.ready: Ready. New orders print by themselves.

station.badLink: This printer link is not valid. Ask the owner for the link in Admin → Printing.
station.silentWarning: Printing is waiting for someone to confirm. Start Chrome with --kiosk-printing (see Admin → Printing) so tickets print without a pop-up.

closing.intro: Every payment taken online on the day, to tick off one by one against the Tap dashboard.

notInTap.title: Marked paid here, not found at Tap

unknown.title: At Tap with no order here
unknown.what: Tap took these payments but no order here has them (another system on the same Tap account, or a test). Check them in the Tap dashboard.
